funding.sign_convention: LONG pays, SHORT receives, on signed notional

execution_law.signal_clock: exec clock, completed bars only: BTCUSDT 15m in both BTC cells; SPY D1. Identical specialist spec across all regime-clock cells (H1/H4/D1); the regime machine owns the regime clock, the specialist owns the exec clock.
execution_law.fill: any signal evaluated on a completed exec bar is filled at the NEXT exec bar open (PIT law); no same-bar flips
execution_law.anti_churn_law: no close/reopen when the target direction is unchanged; a specialist switch mid-position takes effect only at flat or at a direction change; every switch declares its transition delay explicitly
execution_law.exit_precedence: fold force-flat > price stop (intrabar, overrides minimum holding) > maximum-holding time stop > rule exits and regime-change exits (both suppressed until minimum_holding_regime_bars elapse)

notation.HH(i,n): highest high of the n completed bars i-1 .. i-n (trailing only, excludes bar i)
notation.LL(i,n): lowest low of the n completed bars i-1 .. i-n (trailing only, excludes bar i)
notation.EMA20/EMA50: recursive EMA alpha=2/(n+1) seeded with first close (rsmv1.indicators.ema)
notation.SMA20: simple 20-bar mean of close (rsmv1.indicators.sma; equals the BOLL(20,2) mid already in the engine)

transition_unknown_policy.rationale: TRANSITION_UNKNOWN is code-owned abstention: the machine asserts no information, so no forced-flow mechanism can be stated. FLAT is FIXED for this state, not a selectable specialist.

ACCUMULATION.definition_basis: post-decline ranging base: sellers exhausted, downside failures, early accumulation

specialists.economic_mechanism: After a decline has driven price into a base, the forced sellers (liquidated leveraged longs, margin-call and stop-loss sellers, capitulating holders) have already sold; the base exists because passive demand absorbs the residual dribble of supply at the lows. A downside failure — price probes below the prior 20-bar low and the bar CLOSES back above it — proves the probe was absorbed: the sellers who pushed price down had no follow-through. The late traders who entered short on the new low are then trapped above their entry and their covering is forced buying, while value-based buyers who refused to sell at the lows provide the floor. The edge is the asymmetric resolution of that forced cover plus exhausted supply, entered before the mean (SMA20) has been reclaimed, exited at the mean.

entry.condition: low[i] < LL(i,20) AND close[i] > LL(i,20) AND close[i] < SMA20[i]  (failed-low reclaim, still below mean so reversion room remains); evaluated only while flat; fill next exec bar open

exits.name: structural_stop
exits.rule: intrabar: low <= stop_price, where stop_price = min(low[i_signal], LL(i_signal,20)) - 0.5 * ATR14[i_signal], fixed at entry; overrides minimum holding

exits.name: mean_reclaim_target
exits.rule: close >= SMA20[i] on a completed bar -> exit next exec bar open (absorption realized at fair value; engine BOLL-mid exit convention)

exits.name: time_stop
exits.rule: held >= maximum_holding (24 regime bars) -> exit next exec bar open (no follow-through within the absorption horizon means the base is not converting)

exits.name: regime_exit
exits.rule: effective regime is no longer ACCUMULATION -> exit next exec bar open, subject to minimum holding (suppressed until it elapses)

exits.name: fold_force_flat
exits.rule: position closed at fold boundary with close costs charged; overrides everything

stop.rule: half-ATR buffer beyond the structural invalidation (the spring low); if the market re-breaks the failed low the absorption thesis is factually dead

specialists.noop_target_behavior: If already long, target stays LONG and NO order is emitted (no close/reopen). A direction change requires exiting to flat first; no same-bar flip. One position per asset.
specialists.costs_funding_ack: BTCUSDT: 12 bps round trip (5 bps taker + 1 bps slippage per side) and LONG pays funding 1.377e-5 per 8h on signed notional (frozen rate) ~0.41 bps/day, charged every 32 exec bars on the 15m clock. SPY: 10 bps per fill, no funding. The spring-to-mean span must clear these costs on average or the mechanism has no edge; this is stated economics, not a measured result.
specialists.expected_failure_mode: Must lose when the 'base' is actually a pause in an ongoing decline (accumulation misread): the spring low keeps breaking for real and the structural stop pays the full distance repeatedly. Also bleeds in dead, narrow ranges where the spring-to-mean span is smaller than the 12 bps (BTCUSDT) / 20 bps (SPY) round trip plus long funding.

specialists.economic_mechanism: A sustained advance is funded by two semi-forced flows: late participants who missed the move and must buy strength to stay on benchmark, and traders positioned short against the trend whose risk covers sit above every shallow dip. Pullbacks occur when late longs' profit-taking temporarily exhausts new demand; the fast mean (EMA20) is where trend-aligned limit buyers (systematic re-levering, dip programs) rest. When price dips to touch EMA20 and the bar closes back above it, the dip was absorbed by resting demand and the trapped above-dip shorts face rising liquidation risk into a resuming advance. The edge is being the counterparty that dip-sellers need, with the trend filter (EMA20 > EMA50) ensuring the deeper bid of the established advance stands behind the entry.

specialists.economic_mechanism: In an established advance, the area just above the trailing 20-bar high is densely populated by resting sell-to-cover risk stops of traders positioned short against the trend, plus the trigger levels of momentum accounts waiting to buy strength. A close above that level mechanically converts short covering into market buying and pulls benchmark-aware capital off the sidelines — the move through the prior high is itself partially forced. The specialist does not predict the breakout; it positions as the immediate beneficiary of flows that are contractual (stops) or habitual (chase/benchmark buying) once the level trades. Turtle-convention windows make the trigger a public, non-tuned landmark that many forced flows already use.

DISTRIBUTION.definition_basis: post-advance top range: supply meeting late demand, upside failures

specialists.economic_mechanism: After an advance, the remaining buyers are late, capital-constrained momentum chasers while early holders are selling into strength — supply meeting demand at the top. An upside failure — price probes above the prior 20-bar high and the bar CLOSES back below it — proves the probe was supplied, not absorbed. The late buyers who entered on the new high are immediately trapped underwater; their risk stops are forced sell orders resting just below, and range traders who bought the top for breakout follow-through must exit into the same book. The edge is the forced selling of trapped breakout buyers plus dominant supply, entered before the mean (SMA20) has been lost, covered at the mean. SPY is excluded: the long-only authority forbids the short, and no long mechanism exists in a supply-dominated top, so SPY's only conforming choice is FLAT.

entry.condition: high[i] > HH(i,20) AND close[i] < HH(i,20) AND close[i] > SMA20[i]  (failed-high upthrust, still above mean so reversion room remains); BTCUSDT only; evaluated only while flat; fill next exec bar open

specialists.expected_failure_mode: Must lose when the top range resolves UP (the consolidation was re-accumulation, not distribution): the failed-high short is run over by the true breakout and pays the structural stop repeatedly. Also bleeds in wide, tall ranges where upthrusts repeatedly close marginally below the mean target without covering the 12 bps round trip.

DOWNTREND.definition_basis: sustained decline: liquidation cascades, rallies sold

specialists.economic_mechanism: In a sustained decline, the dominant sellers are forced: venue auto-liquidation engines market-sell leveraged longs whose maintenance margin is breached, and those liquidations push price into the next cluster of liquidation levels, feeding the cascade. Discretionary longs' stop-losses are the same flow at smaller size. Sellers in a cascade are price-insensitive — they must execute — while buyers are dipping a falling knife with exhausted capital. The short positioned on a close below the trailing 20-bar low is positioned with the liquidation engine, not against it, and the short's funding receipt (shorts receive at the frozen rate) is a positive carry that the long side of the same trade does not enjoy. The 20-bar breakdown trigger is late by construction, which is the accepted price of only trading confirmed cascades.

specialists.economic_mechanism: In a sustained decline, a standing population of holders has decided to exit but is waiting for a better price; their supply is dormant-contingent, activating only when a rally delivers the liquidity they want. Short-covering bounces give them exactly that: price rallies to the fast mean (EMA20), the waiting sellers execute into it, and the bounce dies — 'rallies sold'. The edge is being short at the price where a known contingent supply activates, with the trend filter (EMA20 < EMA50) ensuring the deeper forced flow (liquidation cascade) stands behind the entry. This is the mirror of dip-buying: the same absorption logic, with trapped longs instead of trapped shorts providing the forced flow.

baseline_expressibility_note: The predecessor cycle's mapping (ACCUMULATION->MR_LONG, UPTREND->TREND_LONG, DISTRIBUTION->FLAT, DOWNTREND->TREND_SHORT BTC-only, TRANSITION_UNKNOWN->FLAT) is expressible from this library alone: ACC-BASE-RECLAIM-L, UPT-DIPBUY-L (or UPT-BREAKOUT-L), FLAT, DNT-CASCADE-S, FLAT-fixed. The single NEW optional element offered to A1 is DIS-FAILED-HIGH-S for BTCUSDT in DISTRIBUTION; choosing FLAT there instead reproduces the conservative baseline with nothing new. A1 owns that choice; A4 records no outcome information for or against it.
notes_for_a1: Indicator vocabulary maps to existing rsmv1.indicators primitives: ema (EMA20/EMA50), sma / bollinger-mid (SMA20), atr Wilder (ATR14). The only new primitive needed is the trailing Donchian window HH/LL over completed bars — pure trailing max/min, must respect the PIT law (exclude the signal bar itself).

Stop model: intrabar (repo stop_hit semantics: low <= stop for LONG, high >= stop for SHORT). The structural stops of ACC-BASE-RECLAIM-L and DIS-FAILED-HIGH-S thread the probe extreme and ATR14 at the signal bar into the entry; implementer must carry both values through the next-open fill.

Exit precedence is declared in execution_law: fold force-flat > price stop > max-hold time stop > rule exits and regime-change exits (the latter two suppressed until minimum_holding_regime_bars elapses). Price stops and fold force-flat are risk controls and are never suppressed by min-hold.

All transition delays are 0 regime bars, declared explicitly: the regime machine's 6-bar min-dwell is the confirmation gate, and specialist indicators are trailing exec-clock windows that do not depend on regime age. No additional specialist-side latency is economically justified.
Sizing is fixed at notional fraction 1.0 everywhere; there are no grids, no per-cell variants, no outcome-informed parameters anywhere in this library.

FLAT is always a valid mapping choice for any (regime, asset); for SPY it is the REQUIRED choice in DISTRIBUTION and DOWNTREND (long-only authority + no long mechanism), and TRANSITION_UNKNOWN is FLAT-fixed by code, not selectable.
